## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. Conflicting signals — strong cyclical breadth led by Energy/Industrials vs concentrated tech weakness (multiple large-cap tech names BELOW TREND/TREND EXHAUSTION), so caution advised; leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +9.26% | 1M: +23.02%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +12.42% | 1M: +5.90%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +10.73% | 1M: +9.21%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: DE (1W: +10.04% | 1M: +16.95%) ABOVE TREND, MMM (1W: +10.98% | 1M: +3.05%) ABOVE TREND. Materials: DOW (1W: +11.08% | 1M: +23.77%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology is lagging: QCOM (1W: -8.97% | 1M: -23.61%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -9.03% | 1M: -21.28%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary also weak: AMZN (1W: -14.09% | 1M: -15.25%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -17.28% | 1M: -22.18%) BELOW TREND. Financials showing mixed internals despite 1W flat-to-up.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: VLO (1W: +12.42% | 1M: +5.90%) ABOVE TREND, CHTR (1W: +11.54% | 1M: +13.61%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +11.08% | 1M: +23.77%) ABOVE TREND, MMM (1W: +10.98% | 1M: +3.05%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +10.73% | 1M: +9.21%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5), signaling cyclical/value leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: QCOM (1W: -8.97% | 1M: -23.61%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -9.03% | 1M: -21.28%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -10.19% | 1M: -32.85%) BELOW TREND, ACN (1W: -11.26% | 1M: -15.99%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -11.97% | 1M: -28.95%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Software/Tech.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: VLO (1W: +12.42%), CHTR (1W: +11.54%), DOW (1W: +11.08%), MMM (1W: +10.98%), DE (1W: +10.04%) — all ABOVE TREND. Note MAJOR divergence: META (1W: -4.13% | 1M: +4.82%) TREND EXHAUSTION, AMD (1W: -12.29% | 1M: +5.53%) TREND EXHAUSTION, JPM (1W: +4.53% | 1M: -2.33%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL, LLY (1W: +0.05% | 1M: -3.73%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL — tactical watch, not broad conviction.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech is under pressure with mixed internals: AAPL (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +6.11%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +2.39% | 1M: +2.70%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: -2.31% | 1M: -13.49%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -5.64% | 1M: -0.34%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -12.29% | 1M: +5.53%) TREND EXHAUSTION — sector showing rotation out of large-cap software into cyclicals; monitor for follow-through.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials mixed but serviceable: JPM (1W: +4.53% | 1M: -2.33%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL, V (1W: -2.47% | 1M: -7.57%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -3.61% | 1M: -7.57%) BELOW TREND, PYPL (1W: -21.36% | 1M: -29.38%) BELOW TREND — breadth is mixed; favor selective banks/cyclicals over payments/fintech laggards.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare constructive: JNJ (1W: +3.42% | 1M: +15.99%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +1.46% | 1M: +8.75%) ABOVE TREND, AMGN (1W: +9.03% | 1M: +13.85%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +0.05% | 1M: -3.73%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL — defensive elements holding while select biotech/drug approvals drive idiosyncratic moves.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclical/value exposures: XOM (1W: +9.26% | 1M: +23.02%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +7.41% | 1M: +22.32%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +11.08% | 1M: +23.77%) ABOVE TREND. Reduce exposure to stretched/weak software and select mega-cap tech showing exhaustion: MSFT (1W: -2.31% | 1M: -13.49%) BELOW TREND, AMZN (1W: -14.09% | 1M: -15.25%) BELOW TREND; major divergence suggests tactical trades, not core reallocations.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: XOM (1W: +9.26% | 1M: +23.02%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +11.08% | 1M: +23.77%) ABOVE TREND, BMY (1W: +8.73% | 1M: +8.71%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: QCOM (1W: -8.97% | 1M: -23.61%) BELOW TREND, AMZN (1W: -14.09% | 1M: -15.25%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -11.97% | 1M: -28.95%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +7.61% | 1M: +11.68%) — strong leadership, Industrials (1W: +5.75% | 1M: +11.42%) and Materials (1W: +5.03% | 1M: +11.76%). BEARISH: Technology (1W: -3.96% | 1M: -4.47%) and Consumer Discretionary (1W: -1.82% | 1M: -2.36%) — watch for continued rotation.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: +2.39% | 1M: +2.70%) ABOVE TREND — watch for sustained 1W follow‑through to confirm momentum. AAPL (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +6.11%) ABOVE TREND — monitor 1W weakness as short-term pullback signal. XOM (1W: +9.26% | 1M: +23.02%) ABOVE TREND — continued energy strength would confirm broader cyclical leadership. MSFT (1W: -2.31% | 1M: -13.49%) BELOW TREND — failure to stabilize next week increases risk of deeper tech weakness.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
BMY (+50): BMY (1W: +8.73% | 1M: +8.71%) ABOVE TREND — earnings/pipeline optimism and price confirm accumulation. NOW (+50): NOW (1W: -11.97% | 1M: -28.95%) BELOW TREND — bullish AI/Anthropic headlines but price diverging (distribution), watch for follow-through or deteriorating sentiment.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
QCOM (-55): QCOM (1W: -8.97% | 1M: -23.61%) BELOW TREND — analyst cuts confirming price weakness. AMD (-45): AMD (1W: -12.29% | 1M: +5.53%) TREND EXHAUSTION — bearish headlines vs mixed 1M performance, watch for trend break. META (-45): META (1W: -4.13% | 1M: +4.82%) TREND EXHAUSTION — regulatory pressure and price pullback signal vulnerability. CVX (-45): CVX (1W: +4.92% | 1M: +14.66%) ABOVE TREND — downgrade contrasts with price strength (divergence), monitor.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, Value/Cyclical style. XOM (1W: +9.26% | 1M: +23.02%) ABOVE TREND and DOW (1W: +11.08% | 1M: +23.77%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence across big-tech names (MSFT, META, AMD, QCOM) and mixed sentiment (NOW bullish headlines with BELOW TREND price; QCOM negative news confirming weakness) — watch for trend breaks.
